predeclared_resolution_method.name: MML_R4_R9_RIMAC_D8_FIRST_INTERSECTION_WITH_PEDREGAL_R7
predeclared_resolution_method.step_1: Map MML R4, R7 and R9 coordinates to the frozen 30 m analysis grid; enumerate coordinate-to-grid ambiguity for R4 and R7 only.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_2: Trace D8 downstream from every admissible R4 cell. For each trace identify the cell nearest R9 and require that the trace progresses toward R9 and reaches within two DEM-cell diagonals of R9.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_3: Treat each R4 trace from its source through its accepted nearest-R9 cell as an admissible event-independent Rimac mainstem path candidate.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_4: Trace D8 downstream from every admissible Pedregal R7 cell and select the first downstream cell that intersects each admissible Rimac path candidate.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_5: Require every R7 x R4 ambiguity combination to yield the same first-intersection cell. Any missing or non-convergent intersection remains PENDING_REVIEW.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_6: Only after convergence may that first-intersection cell be proposed as the Pedregal/San Antonio outlet candidate; basin geometry freezing is a separate downstream step.
